entities.summary: Edgar Aristide Maranta, OFMCap, commonly known as Edgar Maranta was a Swiss prelate of the Catholic Church who spent most of his career in Dar es Salaam, 23 years as apostolic delegate from 1930 to 1953 and 15 years as archbishop.
